cwe_content.cwe: CWE-611,Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

candidate.Reason: XML parsing without disabling external entity processing (XXE vulnerability). DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance() creates a parser with default settings that typically allow external entity references, making it vulnerable to XXE attacks when parsing untrusted XML content.
Parses XML content from app strings resource without proper XXE protection. The content is passed to parseXml() method which uses vulnerable XML parser configuration.
Parses Android manifest XML content without proper XXE protection. The content is passed to parseXml() method which uses vulnerable XML parser configuration.
